adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. That will incorrectly deny access to legitimate team admins who are not owners. Additionally, the authorization check explicitly allows any existing attendee (`isAttendee`) to add guests (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN;`), which is a potentially unsafe permission expansion, though the spec claim itself isn’t verifiable from the diff.
